meaning: Dataset acquisition route.
review_note: Identifies the dataset, rather than a journal characteristic.

meaning: Unique identifier of a delivered journal row.
review_note: Retain for row alignment and audit; assess identity memorization risk.

meaning: Source ID used to acquire this row.
review_note: Identifier; do not interpret its numeric suffix as a quantity.

meaning: Source ID of the returned API object.
review_note: Identifier; compare with source_id for identity checks.

meaning: Recorded identity-resolution status.
review_note: Collection metadata; do not confuse retrieval status with Scopus coverage.

meaning: Timestamp of the Source API acquisition.
review_note: Collection time, not journal establishment or publication time.

meaning: SHA-256 fingerprint of the acquired Source object.
review_note: Integrity evidence; the hash has no substantive numerical meaning.

meaning: Number of dataset rows sharing a resolved Source ID.
review_note: Identity diagnostic; consider duplicate-entity handling before model splitting.

meaning: ISSNs actually used for Scopus matching.
review_note: Outcome-construction evidence; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: Rule used to select ISSNs for matching.
review_note: Outcome-construction metadata; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: Recorded acquisition and attribution basis of language counts.
review_note: Provenance; counts concern Works attributed by primary Source ID.

meaning: Source ID to which the language counts belong.
review_note: Join identifier; not a language characteristic.

meaning: Total Works counted in the language extraction.
review_note: Includes unknown language; may differ from Source works_count.

meaning: Works with a known language code.
review_note: Subset of language_works_count; related count fields are redundant.

meaning: Works with an unknown language code.
review_note: Missing-language count; zero is an observed count, not a missing value.

meaning: Unknown-language Works divided by all counted Works.
review_note: Null for no Works. Interpret as metadata coverage, not a language.

meaning: Counts by language code, including __unknown__.
review_note: Nested distribution; representation remains undecided. Not declared journal language.

meaning: Language proportions using all counted Works as denominator.
review_note: Includes unknown language; empty when there are no Works.

meaning: Language proportions using only known-language Works.
review_note: Different denominator from language_proportions_json; empty if none are known.

meaning: Status of the language aggregation.
review_note: Distinguish no_works from a failed or missing extraction.

meaning: Alternative names recorded for the source.
review_note: Names may identify individual journals; not equivalent to subject categories.

meaning: Listed article-processing charges in their recorded currencies.
review_note: Nested prices; list price is not the amount an author paid.

meaning: Recorded article-processing charge expressed in USD.
review_note: Null does not mean free. Check price date and overlap with apc_prices.

meaning: Recorded annual USD article-processing charges.
review_note: Nested time series; missing years do not mean a zero charge.

meaning: Total citations recorded for the source's Works.
review_note: Cumulative and time dependent; discuss observation date and journal age.

meaning: Country code recorded for the source.
review_note: Does not establish author nationality, readership or publication language.

meaning: Annual work, OA-work and citation counts returned by OpenAlex.
review_note: Nested series; verify year meaning and coverage before deriving features.

meaning: Date the Source record was added to OpenAlex.
review_note: Database entry date, not the journal's founding date.

meaning: Recorded source title.
review_note: Can memorize journal identity; retain for interpretation and audit.

meaning: Earliest publication year recorded for the source.
review_note: Observed indexed history, not necessarily the journal's founding year.

meaning: Recorded source homepage address.
review_note: Raw URL can identify a journal; do not assume it is a meaningful numeric input.

meaning: OpenAlex ID of the hosting organization.
review_note: Publisher or host identity; discuss category handling and unseen organizations.

meaning: Organization IDs in the recorded host hierarchy.
review_note: Nested hierarchy; avoid counting the same organization repeatedly.

meaning: Name of the hosting organization.
review_note: Overlaps with host_organization; names and IDs are alternative representations.

meaning: Source object's OpenAlex identifier.
review_note: Identifier; overlaps with source_id, resolved_id and ids.openalex.

meaning: ISSN list nested within the Source identifiers object.
review_note: Identifiers used in matching; compare with issn before treating as distinct information.

meaning: Linking ISSN nested within the identifiers object.
review_note: Identifier; compare with issn_l and preserve leading zeros.

meaning: Legacy Microsoft Academic Graph identifier.
review_note: Legacy identifier; numeric-looking text is not a measured journal attribute.

meaning: OpenAlex URL nested within the identifiers object.
review_note: Identifier; overlaps with id and collection IDs.

meaning: Wikidata identifier or address.
review_note: External identifier; presence and raw identity are different candidate concepts.

meaning: OpenAlex's CWTS Core source-list flag.
review_note: External-list membership proxy; inspect provenance and overlap with the target.

meaning: OpenAlex flag for a high proportion of OA Works.
review_note: Threshold and time basis require care; overlaps with other OA information.

meaning: Recorded year associated with the high-OA-rate flag.
review_note: Conditional year; null is not year zero and may be structurally inapplicable.

meaning: OpenAlex DOAJ-membership flag.
review_note: External-list membership; discuss timing and relation to the Scopus outcome.

meaning: Recorded year of DOAJ inclusion.
review_note: Conditional year; null is not year zero.

meaning: OpenAlex SciELO-membership flag.
review_note: External-list membership; discuss timing and coverage.

meaning: OpenAlex flag identifying an open-access source.
review_note: Related to OA counts and high-OA-rate flag; examine redundancy and timing.

meaning: OpenAlex flag for the Open Journal Systems platform.
review_note: Platform indicator; not a direct quality judgment.

meaning: OpenAlex flag identifying a preprint repository.
review_note: Check actual variation within this journal-selected cohort.

meaning: Source's recorded ISSN list.
review_note: Identifier list; preserve print/electronic variants and leading zeros.

meaning: Source's linking ISSN.
review_note: Identifier linking ISSN variants; not a numerical scale.

meaning: Latest publication year recorded for the source.
review_note: Does not prove a journal is active or discontinued.

meaning: IDs of external source lists containing this source.
review_note: Inspect individual list IDs for outcome proxies before any encoding.

meaning: Recorded year of conversion to open access.
review_note: Conditional historical event; missing is not year zero.

meaning: Number of recorded open-access Works.
review_note: Overlaps with works_count and OA flags; any ratio needs a defined denominator.

meaning: Scholarly societies associated with the source.
review_note: Nested names and URLs; representation and coverage need discussion.

meaning: OpenAlex's two-year mean-citedness indicator.
review_note: Version-specific indicator; not automatically identical to a commercial impact factor.

meaning: OpenAlex's source h-index.
review_note: Cumulative bibliometric indicator; depends on indexed output and citation history.

meaning: OpenAlex's source i10-index.
review_note: Bibliometric indicator related to citation counts; discuss redundancy.

meaning: Source's share of a topic's Works across all primary sources.
review_note: Separate top-25 list; IDs may differ from topics. Not a within-journal composition.

meaning: Returned topic IDs, names, counts and hierarchy links.
review_note: Up to 25 entries, not complete subject coverage. Level and encoding remain open; [] does not prove no subject.

meaning: OpenAlex Source type.
review_note: B was selected as journal; inspect actual variation before considering a predictor.

meaning: Source record's last recorded update timestamp.
review_note: Database maintenance date, not a journal event.

meaning: API address for Works associated with the source.
review_note: Convenience URL containing source identity; not substantive topic information.

meaning: Total Works recorded on the Source object.
review_note: May differ from language_works_count because of acquisition time or counting basis.

meaning: Validated ISSNs retained by the matching procedure.
review_note: Matching evidence; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: ISSN strings rejected by validation.
review_note: Matching diagnostic; invalid identifiers do not establish non-inclusion.

meaning: Field-level record of ISSN evidence used in matching.
review_note: Outcome-construction evidence; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: Categorical result of the reference-list match.
review_note: Outcome-related status; not an eligible predictor of that same outcome.

meaning: Number of candidate Scopus source identities.
review_note: Matching diagnostic; multiple candidates require resolution, not automatic labeling.

meaning: Candidate Scopus source IDs.
review_note: Outcome-related identities; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: ISSNs supporting the candidate match.
review_note: Outcome-construction evidence; keep separate from predictor inputs.

meaning: Full candidate records retained by the matcher.
review_note: Contains target-related reference information; keep outside predictor inputs.

meaning: Reference source types among the matching candidates.
review_note: Reference-label evidence; not OpenAlex's source type.

meaning: Flag for inconsistent reference-status evidence.
review_note: Matching diagnostic; false is distinct from an unknown label.

meaning: Flag for discontinued-status evidence in the reference.
review_note: Outcome-related status; not a general journal-closure determination.

meaning: Evidence from the separate accepted/pending reference list.
review_note: Pending is distinct from included or absent; retain as audit evidence.

meaning: Membership label for the pinned Scopus reference list.
review_note: 1 unique included identity; 0 valid-ISSN non-match; blank unresolved. Outcome candidate, never a predictor.

meaning: Active-Journal label under the pinned Scopus reference rules.
review_note: Blank is unresolved, not negative. Outcome candidate, never a predictor; choose the target separately.

meaning: Version of the Scopus reference workbook used.
review_note: Label provenance; not a journal predictor. August 2026 reference is fixed.
